title: Seahawks DT Jarran Reed: Players hit penalty issues "head on" in meeting this week

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Seahawks DT Jarran Reed: Players hit penalty issues "head on" in meeting this week
sources.description: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald called the team's seven personal fouls in last Sunday's win over the Chargers "unacceptable at any level" and his players didn't wait to go to work on cleaning things up this week.
